mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_field (field_code, table_code, field_name, field_type, label, is_required, form_component, validate_rule, sort, is_enabled, business_code) VALUES (#{fieldCode}, #{tableCode}, #{fieldName}, #{fieldType}, #{label}, #{isRequired}, #{formComponent}, #{validateRule}, #{sort}, #{isEnabled, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{businessCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: UPDATE metadata_field SET field_name = #{fieldName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, field_type = #{fieldType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, label = #{label, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, is_required = #{isRequired, jdbcType=INTEGER}, form_component = #{formComponent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, validate_rule = #{validateRule, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sort = #{sort, jdbcType=INTEGER}, is_enabled = #{isEnabled, jdbcType=INTEGER}, business_code = #{businessCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT tc.constraint_name, CASE WHEN kcu.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLUMN' ELSE 'TABLE' END AS constraint_level FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema AND tc.table_name = kcu.table_name WHERE tc.table_schema = DATABASE() AND tc.table_name = #{tableName} AND tc.constraint_type = 'CHECK'

-- 查询常规约束 SELECT tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type, kcu.column_name, CASE WHEN kcu.column_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLUMN' ELSE 'TABLE' END AS constraint_level, CASE WHEN tc.constraint_type = 'CHECK' THEN cc.check_clause ELSE tc.constraint_name END AS constraint_content FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = kcu.table_schema AND tc.table_name = kcu.table_name LEFT JOIN information_schema.check_constraints cc ON tc.constraint_name = cc.constraint_name AND tc.table_schema = cc.constraint_schema WHERE tc.table_schema = DATABASE() AND tc.table_name = #{tableName} UNION ALL -- 查询非空约束 SELECT CONCAT('NN_', c.column_name) AS constraint_name, 'NOT NULL' AS constraint_type, c.column_name, 'COLUMN' AS constraint_level, 'NOT NULL' AS constraint_content FROM information_schema.columns c WHERE c.table_schema = DATABASE() AND c.table_name = #{tableName} AND c.IS_NULLABLE = 'NO' AND c.COLUMN_KEY != 'PRI' -- 排除主键（主键自带非空约束）
